paragraphs.paragraph_text: A limited number of suppliers provide certain critical components. Replacing these suppliers may require time and significant expense.
Rapid technological change and intense competition may reduce demand for our offerings or require additional investment to remain competitive.
Evolving data protection, competition, and product-safety requirements may require substantial changes to our business practices.

Management continues to monitor revenue growth, operating expenses, working capital, and capital allocation. Results may be affected by customer demand, product mix, foreign exchange movements, and changes in the cost of operations.
